headline: Polling is under way on Sunday in by-elections for NA-77 and PP-203 in Punjab, seats vacated after the deaths of MNA Chaudhry Mehmood Bashir Virk and MPA Chaudhry Muhammad Hanif Jutt, with 185 polling stations set up for PP-203, Dawn reports.

card.desc: PP-203 mein 185 polling stations par polling ho rahi hai

caption:
Punjab ke 2 halqon NA-77 aur PP-203 mein by-election ki polling jari!
Dawn ke mutabiq NA-77 ki seat MNA Chaudhry Mehmood Bashir Virk aur PP-203 ki seat PML-N MPA Chaudhry Muhammad Hanif Jutt ke inteqal ke baad khali hui thi. PP-203 mein 185 polling stations banaye gaye hain aur taqreeban 1,370 polling staff tainaat hai.
Kya aap ne kabhi by-election mein vote dala hai? Comment mein batayein 👇
